description.value: Blenz Coffee is a BC-born specialty coffee chain founded in Vancouver in 1992, with this location inside Orchard Park Shopping Centre on Harvey Avenue in Kelowna. The café offers handcrafted espresso drinks, nitro coffee, whole-leaf teas, protein shakes, and a broad food menu including breakfast sandwiches, wraps, and baked goods. It is a locally owned and operated franchise in a busy mall setting on Kelowna's main commercial strip.
